27:56: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "ssuffɣet tawacult n Luṭ, si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen i ibɣan tezdeg".
27:57: Nsellek it, neţţa akked twacult is, siwa tameṭṭut is. Nseyya a ţţili seg wid igwran.
27:58: Nesseɣli d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid iţţunedṛen!
27:59: Ini: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi. Talwit i imdanen iS, wid Ifren". Pţif Ṛebbi, neɣ ayen ţcaraken?
27:60: Day Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i wen d Isseɣlin aman, seg igenni - Nessenkar, yissen, iqwiṛen iţţembehwaoen, ur teḥwaoem a d tessemɣim ttjuṛ is -, day illa ṛebbi, ar tama n Ṛebbi? Maca, nitni d agdud issaɛdalen.
27:61: Day Win Irran tamurt d tanezduɣt, Irra degs isaffen, Irra yas idurar, Irra agadir ger sin ilellen, day illa ṛebbi ar tama n Ṛebbi? Xaṭi, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
27:62: Day Win Issemḥasen i umeḍṛuṛ, mara S d isiwel; Itekksen ayen n dir; i kwen Iţţaran d igensas di tmurt; day illa ṛebbi, ar tama n Ṛebbi? Drus id tesmektayem.
27:63: Day Win i kwen Inehhun, di tillas n lberr akked yill, id Iţţaznen aḍu, d abecceṛ n ccira uḥunu S; day illa ṛebbi, ar tama n Ṛebbi? Ay Aɛlay Ṛebbi, sennig wayen ţcaraken!
27:64: Day Win Ibeddun lxelq, sinna, Iţţales as; ikwen Iɣaten seg igenni akked tmurt; day illa ṛebbi ar tama n Ṛebbi? Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tideţ"!
27:65: Ini: "tabaḍnit, di tmurt akked igenwan, ur ţ issin yiwen siwa Ṛebbi. Ur ẓṛin melmi ara d kkren".
27:66: Ih, tamusni nnsen ur tessaweḍ ar laxeṛt? Xaṭi, nitni di ccekk fellas. Xaṭi, nitni, fellas, dreɣlen.
27:67: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ma nuɣal d akal, am imezwura nneɣ, s tideţ, fellaɣ tanekra?
27:68: Niɣ waɛɛden aɣ aya, i nekwni akw i imezwura nneɣ, zik. Ayagi, d timucuha kan imenza".
27:69: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek teḍṛa d ibeɣwḍiyen".
27:70: Ur ɣwebben fellasen, ur ţxiqqi ilmend n nncub nnsen.
27:71: Nnan: "melmi lemɛahda agi, ma d tideţ ay tessawalem"?
27:72: Ini: "kra n wayen iɣef tḥarem, ahat atan iḍfeṛ kwen id".
27:73: Mass ik, s tideţ, meqqweṛ lfeḍl iS, ɣef imdanen. Maca, tegwti degsen ur snemmiren.
27:74: Mass ik, s tideţ, Iẓṛa ayen teffren idmaren nnsen, akked wayen d qqaṛen.
27:75: Ur illi wayen iffren, deg igenni akked tmurt, ur nuri di Tezmamt iţbegginen.
27:76: Ih, Leqwṛan agi iḥekku d i At Isṛail, tegwti n wayen iɣef mgarraden.
27:77: Neţţa, war ccekk, ard nnhaya akked uḥunu i lmumnin.
27:78: Mass ik, s tideţ, ad Iseyyi garasen s uḥuddu S. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Amusnaw.
27:79: Pţkel ɣef Ṛebbi, ih, aql ak di tideţ iţbegginen.
27:80: Ih, kečč, ur teţţaraḍ lmeggtin ad slen, ur teţţaraḍ iɛeẓẓugen ad slen i wancad, ma wexxṛen.
27:81: Ur fellak nnhaya iderɣalen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara islen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ. Nitni d imḍuɛen.
27:82: Mi iṣaṛ wawal fellasen, ad asen d Nessuffeɣ lweḥc si tmurt; ad asen yini ar imdanen ur metbutit ɣef issekniyen nneɣ.
27:83: Ass ideg ara d Nefser, si yal lois, arbaɛ n wid inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, d tirni,
27:84: alamma, mi d usan, ad Yini: "day tnekṛem issekniyen iW, ur ten teskecmem di tmusni? Neɣ d acu tellam txeddmem"?
27:85: Iṣaṛ wawal fellasen, imi densen. Ur d ţmeslayen.
27:86: Day ur walan ara ar Nerra yasen iḍ i ureyyeḥ nnsen, ass iwakken ad walin? Deg wayagi, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
27:87: Ass uṣuḍu n lbuq, ad iagwad i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, siwa wid i S ihwan i Ṛebbi. A d asen akw ɣuṛeS, s uḥiwet.
27:88: A ţwaliḍ idurar i tɣileḍ sebken, la teddun am usigna. D igi n Ṛebbi i Iṣegmen yal cci. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iẓṛa d acu txedmem.
27:89: Win id iusan s iseɣ, ad iawi it yifen. Widak, assen, meḍmunit si tugdi.
27:90: Wid id iusan s tucmiţ, ad ţţin wudmawen nnsen ar tmes. Niɣ a ţţeţţuqeṭṭim kan ɣef wayen txeddmem?
27:91: Pwamṛeɣ kan ad ɛabdeɣ Mass n temdint agi, i Iṛqa. IneS yal cci. Pwamṛeɣ d ad iliɣ seg imduɛen,
27:92: ad maleɣ Leqwṛan. Win iţwanhan, iţwanha kan i iman is. Win innetlafen, ini: "nek d aneddaṛ kan".
27:93: Ini: "a neckeṛ Ṛebbi. Ad awen Issken issekniyen iS. A ten tɛaqlem". Mass ik ur Iɣeffel ara ɣef wayen txeddmem.
28:3: Ad ak d Neḥku si teqṣiṭ n Musa akked Ferɛun, s tideţ, i ugdud iumnen.
28:4: Ih, Ferɛun issemɣweṛ iman is di tmurt; imezdaɣ ifeṛq iten d iḥṛumen. Isrewrew ṭayfa segsen, izellu arrac nnsen, issidir tilawin nnsen. Ih, neţţa seg ifessaden.
28:5: Nebɣa a Nfeṛṛeo ɣef wid irewrwen di tmurt, a ten Nerr d imeqwṛanen, a ten Nerr d iweṛṛaten.
28:6: A ten Nesseqɛad di tmurt. A Nessken i Ferɛun, Haman, akked iɛsekṛiwen nnsen, ayen ţţagwaden segsen.
28:7: Nweḥḥa i imma s n Musa: "ssuṭṭeḍ it, sinna, ma tugadeḍ fellas, err it ar wasif. Ur ţţagwad, ur ɣwebben. Ad am t id Nerr, u a t Nerr seg imazanen".
28:8: Teddem it twacult n Ferɛun. Ad asen iuɣal d acengu, d aɣilif. Ih, Ferɛun, Haman, akked iɛsekṛiwen nnsen llan d imsaben.
28:9: Tenna tmeṭṭut n Ferɛun: "d nnṣib n tiṭ, i nek akked kečč. Ur tneqq, ahat ad aɣ infaɛ, neɣ a t nerr d mmit nneɣ". Nitni ur faqen ara.
28:10: Temmar ed tasa n yimma s n Musa. Qṛib it id tessken, lemmer ur Nzeyyeṛ ara ul is, iwakken a ţţili si lmumnin.
28:11: Tenna i ultma s: "eḍfeṛ it"! Teqquṛa t si mbɛid, nitni ur faqen.
28:12: Uqbel, Negdel as tid iṣṣuṭuḍen. Tenna: "ad awen ssekneɣ axxam ar awen itkwelfen fellas, u nitni ad as bedden"?
28:13: Nerra t id i imma s, iwakken ad as kkawent wallen is, ur tɣwebben, iwakken a ţẓeṛ ar lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
28:14: Mi meqqweṛ, ittaɛqel, Nefka yas tussna, ṣṣwab. Akka ay Neţkafi imdanen lɛali.
28:15: Ikcem tamdint, di lweqt ideg stehzan imezdaɣ is. Iufa n sin irgazen ţnaɣen, yiwen seg uḥṛum is, wayeḍ seg icenga s. Win n uḥṛum is, issuter as d afus, mgal win n icenga s. Iwwet it Musa s lbunia, inɣa t. Inna: "ayagi, seg igi n Cciṭan. Neţţa, s tideţ, d acengu n ṣṣeḥ, itellifen".
28:16: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek denseɣ iman iw, Semmeḥ iyi". Isemmeḥ as. Ih, Neţţa Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
28:17: Inna: "a Mass iw! S lɣit iK felli, ur ţţiliɣ, d awezɣi, si loiha ibeɣwḍiyen".
28:18: Iufa d iman is di temdint, iugad, iquṛaɛ. Atan a d iţɛaggiḍ ɣuṛes, win i s d issutren afus, ass izeryen. Inna yas Musa: "kečč, s tideţ, d imɣeṛṛeq n ṣṣeḥ".
28:19: Acengu nnsen, mi ibɣa a t iwwet, inna d: "a Musa! Day tebɣiḍ ad iyi tenɣeḍ, akken tenɣiḍ yiwen, iḍelli? Tebɣiḍ kan a ţţiliḍ d aqehhaṛ di tmurt, ur tebɣiḍ ara a ţţiliḍ seg iɛaṛḍiyen".
28:20: Iusa d urgaz si ṭṭerf n temdint, iţţazal. Inna d: "a Musa! S tideţ, imḍebbṛen mlalen ɣef loal ik, a k nɣen. Effeɣ, nek, seg wid ik iţweṣṣin".
28:21: Iffeɣ segs, iugad, iquṛaɛ. Inna: "a Mass iw! Sellek iyi seg ugdud imednas".
28:22: Mi ibbwi tikli ar Madian, inna: "ahat Mass iw ad iyi Iawi d ubrid umɛin".
28:23: Mi ibbweḍ s aman n Madian, iufa n arbaɛ n lɣaci, la sswan. Iufa, di ṭṭerf nnsen, snat n tlawin, ṭṭfent lmal nnsent. Inna: "d acu txeddmemt"? Nnant ed: "ur nesswa alamma wexxṛen imeksawen. Babat neɣ d amɣaṛ ameqwṛan".
28:24: Issew asent, iuɣal ar tili, inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ṛeɣbeɣ ɣef yal lxiṛ, ar iyi d Tesserseḍ".
28:25: Tusa t id yiwet segsent, s tikli ikukran, tenna: "atan ak d issawal baba, a k ikafi imi ɣ tessweḍ". Mi iṛuḥ ɣuṛes, u iḥka yas i iḍṛan, inna: "ur ţţagwad, teţwasellkeḍ seg ugdud imednas".
28:26: Yiwet segsent, tenna: "a baba! Eṭṭef it d acrik, ih, yif icriken ik, iohed, muman".
28:27: Inna: "bɣiɣ, nek, ad ak fkeɣ yiwet si yissi yagi, s cceṛt a ţxedmeḍ ɣuṛi ṭam iseggwasen. Ma tessawdeḍ mraw, s lebɣi k. Ur bɣiɣ a k hejjneɣ. Ad ak iliɣ, ma Irad Ṛebbi, seg iɛaṛḍiyen".
28:28: Irra: "ayagi, gari yidek. A tin sɛaddaɣ ger snat n tallitin, ur iţţili felli uɣilif. Ṛebbi d Awkil, ɣef wayen id nenna".
28:29: Mi ifukk Musa tallit, u iseyyeḥ akked twacult is, iwala times ar tama n udrar. Inna i twacult is: "qqimet, walaɣ times, ahat ad awen d awiɣ, segs, asali neɣ asafu, amar a ţţesseḥmum".
28:30: Mi ibbweḍ ɣuṛes, iţwanced ed si ttejṛa, di rif ayeffus n teɣzut, deg umḍiq iṛqan: "a Musa! S tideţ, Nek d Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
28:31: Veggeṛ taɛkwazt ik". Mi ţ iwala, la tesseḥṛiṭiw amzun d azrem, ibren ur iwexxeṛ. "A Musa! Qeddem, ur ţţagwad, aql ak, ih, di laman.
28:32: Err afus ik di loib ik, a d iffeɣ d amellal, ur ihlik. Sseqṛeb ed ɣuṛek iɣil ik, ad ak tekkes tugwdi. Tigi d sin n ţţbut sɣuṛ Mass ik, i Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Ih, nitni d agdud iballaɣen".
28:33: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek nɣiɣ yiwen segsen, ugadeɣ ad iyi nɣen.
28:34: Gma Harun yif iyi afeṣṣeḥ umeslay. Azen it id yidi d amɛiwen, ad iyi tebbet. Nek ugadeɣ ad iyi nekṛen".
28:35: Inna: "a Nesseohed tayeţţ ik s gma k. Ad awen Nefk, i sin, adabu; ur kwen id ţţawḍen. S issekniyen nneɣ, d kunwi akked wid iddan yidwen ara irebḥen".
28:36: Mi ibbweḍ ɣuṛsen Musa, s issekniyen iberrzen, nnan: "ayagi, siwa ssḥur id innulfan. Ur nesli s waya, ɣuṛ ibabaten nneɣ imezwura".
28:37: Inna Musa: "Mass iw Iẓṛa sennig wiyaḍ, anwa iwumi Ifka nnhaya sɣuṛeS, anwa ara d igwrin deg Uxxam. Imednas, s tideţ, ur rebḥen".
28:38: Inna Ferɛun: "a yimḍebbṛen, ur awen mliɣ ara kra n ṛebbi, war nekkini. Ecɛal iyi times ar talaxt, a Haman; bnu yi lbeṛo aɛlayen; ahat ad aliɣ ar ṚṚebbi n Musa. Nek, s tideţ, ḥesbeɣ t seg wid iskiddiben".
28:39: Neţţa, akked iɛsekṛiwen is, smeɣwṛen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. ɣilen, ar nitni, ur d ţţuɣalen ɣuṛneɣ.
28:40: Neţţa, akked iɛsekṛiwen is, Neṭṭef iten. Nger iten ar yill. Wali amek teḍṛa d imednas.
28:41: Nerra ten d imeqwṛanen i ineccden ar tmes. Ass n tnekra, ur ţţusellken.
28:42: Neqqen asen xezzu di ddunit agi. Ass n tnekra, nitni seg ucmiten.
28:43: Niɣ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, mbaɛd ma Nesqucc isuta imezwura. D tafat i imdanen, d nnhaya u d aḥunu. Amar a d mmektin.
28:44: Ur telliḍ ara di loiha utaram, mi Nseyya lameṛ i Musa. Ur telliḍ seg inagan.
28:45: Maca, Nxelq ed tisuta, ɣwezzif laɛmeṛ nnsent. Ur tellid seg imezdaɣ n Madian, la sen teqqareḍ issekniyen nneɣ. Maca, Nella Neţţazen.
28:46: Ur telliḍ ar tama n udrar, mi d Nessawel. Maca d aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik, iwakken a ţnedreḍ agdud, uɣuṛ ur d iusi uneddaṛ, uqbel ik. Amar a d mmektin.
28:47: Mulac, ma tḥuza ten tiyta id urwen ifassen nnsen, a d inin: "a Mass nneɣ! A lemmer i ɣ d Tuzneḍ amazan, a neddu d issekniyen iK, a nili seg wid iumnen"!
28:48: Mi ten id tusa tideţ sɣuṛneɣ, nnan: "a lemmer id iusi am wayen id iusan i Musa"! Day ur ugin ara, zik, ayen id iusan i Musa? Nnan: "d sin ssḥurat". Mwafaqen, nnan: "nekwni nugi ten i sin".
28:49: Ini: "awit ed Tazmamt, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, i yifen snat agi, i nnhaya, ad dduɣ yides, ma tessawalem tideţ".
28:50: Ma ur ak d rran ara, efhem ar ddan kan d lhawiyyat nnsen. Anwa innetlafen, sennig win iteddun d lhawiyya s, war nnhaya sɣuṛ Ṛebbi? Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
28:51: Aql aɣ Nessawweḍ asen awal, amendeṛ ma d mmektin.
28:52: Umnen yis wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, uqbel tagi.
28:53: Ma ɣṛan asen t, ad inin: "numen yis. Ih, ar neţţa d tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass nneɣ. Uqbel is, s tideţ, nella d imḍuɛen".
28:54: Wigi a ten id ias ukafi nnsen berdayen, ɣef wayen ṣebṛen, swexxiṛen tucmiţ s yiseɣ, u seg wayen iten Nɣat, ţseddiqen.
28:55: Mi slan i yir awal, ad as ḍeṛfen, u qaṛen: "i nekwni igiten nneɣ, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Fellawen talwit. Ur neṛɣeb ɣef at war tussna".
28:56: Kečč, s tideţ, ur tnehhuḍ win tḥemleḍ. Maca, Ṛebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neţţa, Yif akw akken Iẓṛa wid iţwanhan.
28:57: Nnan: "ma nedda d nnhaya yidek, a neţwaxḍef seg wakal nneɣ". Day ur ten Nesseqɛad ara di loamaɛ n laman, uɣuṛ d ţţawḍent yal lɣellat? D lɣit sɣuṛneɣ. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ẓṛin.
28:58: Acḥal Nesqucc n temdininn, cerrɛent di temɛict nnsent. Atnan ixxamen nnsen, ay ten izedɣen, deffir sen, siwa ixeṭṭayen. D Nekwni ay d iweṛṛaten.
28:59: Ur Isquccu Mass ik timdinin, alamma iuzen i imezdaɣ nnsent, amazan i sen immalen issekniyen nneɣ. Ur Nesquccu timdinin, mebla ma llan imezdaɣ nnsent, d imednas.
28:60: Kra n wayen i wen iţţunefken n cci, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuḥ is. Ayen illan ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, yif it, ad idum kter. Day ur ţmeyyizen ara?
28:61: Day win iwumi Nefka lemɛahda igerzen, u immuger iţ, am win i Nezha s lɣit n tmeddurt n ddunit; sinna, ass n tnekra, neţţa seg wid ara d irsen?
28:62: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "anda ten wid iyY teţcarakem, u tellam teţkabarem"?
28:63: A d inin wid iɣef iṣaṛ wawal: "a Mass nneɣ! Wigi i njeggeḥ, njeggeḥ iten, akken i neţwajeggeḥ. A nzekki ɣureK: mačči d nekwni ay ɛabden".
28:64: Ad asen inin: "naɛṛet wid teţcarakem". Ad ten naɛṛen, ur asen d ţţaran. Walan aɛaqeb. A lemmer llan ţwanhan!
28:65: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "acu d terram i imazanen"?
28:66: Assen, ad dergen fellasen isalen, nitni ur ţmesteqsayen.
28:67: Ma d win isteṛoɛen, iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, ahat ad yili seg imerbaḥ.
28:68: Mass ik Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan, u Ismenyafa. Ur ten id iṣaḥ usmenyif. Gedha s Ṛebbi! I Aɛlay sennig wayen ţcaraken!
28:69: Mass ik Iẓṛa ayen iffren deg idmaren nnsen, akked wayen cennɛen.
28:70: Neţţa d Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. I Neţţa, annuz di tmezwarut, u di tneggarut. I Neţţa aḥuddu, ɣuṛeS tuɣalin nnwen.
28:71: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Isseɣli d Ṛebbi iḍ imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ṛebbi, war Ṛebbi, ara wen d iawin tafat? Day ur tsellem ara"?
28:72: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Issuli Ṛebbi ass imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ṛebbi, war Ṛebbi, ara wen d iawin iḍ, a ţţestaɛfum degs? Day ur teţwalim ara"?
28:73: Seg uḥunu S, Iga yawen iḍ akked wass, i ustaɛfu nnwen, akked unadi n lfeḍl iS. Amar a ţţesnemmrem.
28:74: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad asen Yini: "anda ten wid iyY teţcarakem, u tellam teţkabarem"?
28:75: A d Nawi anagi, si yal lois. A Nini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ad ẓṛen ar tideţ n Ṛebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
28:76: Ih, Qaṛun illa seg ugdud n Musa. Iqehṛ iten. Nefka yas igerrujen; s tezmert ugraw ioehden, arfad n tsura nnsen. Mi s inna ugdud is: "ur zehhu! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara izehwaniyen.
28:77: Deg wayen i k Ifka Ṛebbi, nadi axxam aneggaru. Ur teţţu amur ik, di ddunit. Elhu, akken i Ilha Ṛebbi ɣuṛek. Ur ssaram lefsad di tmurt. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ifessaden".
28:78: Inna: "iţţunefk iyi kan, ilmend n tmusni i sɛiɣ". Day ur iẓṛa ara ar Ṛebbi Isqucc, uqbel is, ger isuta, wid i t iugaren di tezmert, isemmden kteṛ? Ur illi usteqsi ibeɣwḍiyen, af ibekkaḍen nnsen.
28:79: Iffeɣ ed s agdud is, s ṛṛḥuḥ is. Wid ibɣan tameddurt n ddunit, nnan: "awufan nesɛa am wayen iţţunefken i Qaṛun! Ih, neţţa d bab n terkunt tabarart".
28:80: Wid, iwumi teţţunefk tmusni, nnan: "a ssexḍ nnwen! Pţwab n Ṛebbi yif it, i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ara d iṣaḥ siwa win iṣebṛen".
28:81: Nger it seddaw tmurt, neţţa akked uxxam is. Ur as telli terbaɛt ara t isellken, war Ṛebbi. Ur illi seg wid iţselliken iman nnsen.
28:82: Wid issaramen amkan is, iḍelli nni, uɣalen nnan: "ziɣ Ṛebbi Issugut ṛṛeẓq i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u iwezzen. Lemmer ur aɣ Iɣat ara Ṛebbi, yili Iger aɣ seddaw tmurt. Ih, ur rebḥen ijehliyen".
28:83: Axxam nni aneggaru, a t Nerr i wid ijunben temɣweṛ akked usefsed, di tmurt. Tirect i wid iţḥezziben.
28:84: Win id iusan s yiseɣ, ad iawi ayen it yifen. Win id iusan s tucmiţ, ihi, ad ţţuqeṭṭin wid ixedmen tucmitin, ɣef wayen kan xeddmen.
28:85: Ih, Win Ilezmen fellak Leqwṛan, war ccekk, a k id Irr s axxam. Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Issen anwa id iusan s nnhaya, anwa i illan di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ".
28:86: Ur tessarmeḍ ara, ad ak ed ters Tezmamt, lemmer mačči d aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ur ţţili d amɛiwen ijehliyen.
28:87: Ur k swexxiṛen seg issekniyen n Ṛebbi, deffir trusi nnsen ɣuṛek. Nuj ar Mass ik, ur ţţili seg wid iţcaraken.
28:88: Ur nɛaṛ, ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen. Ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa. Yal cci ad inger, siwa udem iS. IneS aḥuddu. ɣureS ara tuɣalem.
29:2: Day ɣilen imdanen a ten ooen qqaṛen: "numen", u nitni ur ţţuhewwlen?
29:3: Niɣ Nhewwel wid i ten id izwaren. War ccekk, ad Yissin Ṛebbi wid iqqaṛen tideţ, ad Yissin ikeddaben.
29:4: Neɣ ɣilen ad aɣ zwiren wid ixedmen tucmitin? Dir it wayen ţḥuddun.
29:5: Win iggunin timlilit akked Ṛebbi, s tideţ, a d ias, war ccekk, lajel n Ṛebbi. Neţţa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
29:6: Win ijuhden, ijuhed kan i iman is. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥwao ara imaḍalen.
29:7: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, ad asen Nekkes tucmitin nnsen, a ten Nkafi ɣef wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
29:8: Nweṣṣa amdan ar lewqama, s imawlan is. Ma lezmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkeḍ ayen ur tessineḍ, ur asen ţţaɣ awal. Tuɣalin nnwen, ɣuṛI. Ad awen Mleɣ acu txeddmem.
29:9: Wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, a ten Nessekcem ar iɛaṛḍiyen.
29:10: Ger imdanen, wid iqqaṛen: "numen s Ṛebbi". Ma meḥnen, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ad ḥesben ahewwel n medden, d aɛaqeb n Ṛebbi. Mi d iusa lɣelb, sɣuṛ Mass ik, ar ad inin: "ih, nella yidwen". Day ur Iẓṛa ara Ṛebbi, i illan deg idmaren imaḍalen?
29:11: War ccekk, Ṛebbi Issen wid iumnen, Issen ixabiten.
29:12: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "ddut d ubrid nneɣ, a nbibb tuccḍa nnwen". Nitni ur ţbibbin acemma, si tuccḍa nnsen. S tideţ, nitni d ikeddaben.
29:13: War ccekk, ad bibben tiɛekkwmin nnsen, akked tiɛekkwmin nniḍen. Ih, ad ţţusteqsin, ass n tnekra, af wayen id snulfuyen.
29:14: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ, i ugdud is. Izdeɣ yides, agim kkes ed smuset iseggwasen. Ibbwi ten uḥemmal, nitni d imednas.
29:15: Nsellek it, neţţa akked wid iddan di lbabuṛ. Nerra t d assekni i imaḍalen.
29:16: Ibṛahim, mi inna i ugdud is: "ɛabdet Ṛebbi, ḥezzbet aS. Yif it wakka, i kunwi, lemmer teẓṛim.
29:17: Tɛabdem kan tiɛancuṛin, war Ṛebbi. Tesnulfam d tikerkas. Ih, wid tɛabdem, war Ṛebbi, ur zmiren a kwen ɣiten. Ssutret lɣit i Ṛebbi, ɛabdet eP, snemmret aS. ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem.
29:18: Ma tnekṛem, ihi, uqbel nnwen, nekṛen leoyus". I iwatan, i umazan, siwa assiweḍ ubeggen.
29:19: Day ur walan ara, amek id Inezzu Ṛebbi lxelq, sinna, Iţţales as. Ih, ayagi, i Ṛebbi, d ushil.
29:20: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek id Inza lxelq. Sinna, Ṛebbi a d Iawi lxelq aneggaru. Ih, Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci".
29:21: Ikkat win i S ihwan; Iţḥunu ɣef win i S ihwan. ɣureS jebbu nnwen.
29:22: Ur tesfunnugem, kunwi, di tmurt, neɣ deg igenni. Ur tesɛim, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ asettaṛ.
29:23: Wid iugin issekniyen n Ṛebbi, akked temlilit yideS, widak ad aysen aḥunu W. I widak, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
29:24: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "enɣet eţ, neɣ sseṛɣet eţ". Isellek it Ṛebbi, si tmes. Deg waya, s tideţ, d assekni i ugdud iumnen.
29:25: Inna: "teddmem kan tiɛancuṛin, war Ṛebbi. Temḥemmalem di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ass n tnekra, kra degwen ad nekṛen wiyaḍ, kra ad xzun wiyaḍ. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi usellak".
29:26: Iumen it Luṭ. Inna: "nek, d iminig ar Mass iw. Ih, Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab".
29:27: Nɣat it s Isḥaq akked Yaɛqub. I tarwas, Nefka lambiyya, Tazmamt. Nefka yas taqḍiɛt is, di ddunit; u neţţa, di laxeṛt, war ccekk, seg iɛaṛḍiyen.
29:28: Luṭ, mi inna i ugdud is: "ih, aql akwen la txedmem lɛaṛ, ur ixdim yiwen, zik, deg imaḍalen.
29:29: La teţţeddum, ih, ar irgazen, tgezzmem abrid, txeddmem ayen icemten, deg igrawen nnwen". Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi nnan: "awi aɣ d aɛaqeb n Ṛebbi, ma telliḍ seg wid issawalen tideţ".
29:30: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi afus, mgal agdud ifessaden".
29:31: Mi d usan imceggɛen nneɣ, ar Ibṛahim, s ubecceṛ, nnan as: "ih, a Nesqucc imezdaɣ n temdint agi. Imezdaɣ is, s tideţ, d imednas".
29:32: Inna d: "niɣ degs Luṭ". Nnan as: "Nekwni, Neẓṛa sennig akw, i illan degs. A t Naɛteq, neţţa akked twacult is, siwa tameṭṭut is, ara yilin seg wid igwran".
29:33: Mi usan imceggɛen nneɣ, ar Luṭ, iɣwbel ilmend nnsen, ur izmir a ten ifukk. Nnan as: "ur ţţagwad, ur ɣwebbel. Nekwni a k Naɛteq, kečč d twacult ik, siwa tameṭṭut ik, ara yilin seg wid igwran.
29:34: Ih, nekwni a d Nesseɣli ssxeḍ seg igenni, ɣef imezdaɣ n temdint agi, ilmend n lɛaṛ nnsen".
29:35: Niɣ Neooa d segs, assekni iberrzen, i ugdud iţmeyyizen.
29:36: Ar Madian, gmat sen Cuɛayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi, gganit ass aneggaru, ur oouṛut di tmurt d ifessaden!".
29:37: Nekṛen t. Tewwet iten zzenzla. Gwran d, d loeţţat, deg ixxamen nnsen.
29:38: Ɛad akked Tamud - niɣ iban awen d seg ixxamen nnsen -, icebbeḥ asen Cciṭan igiten nnsen. Issuffeɣ iten seg ubrid, nitni ţfeṛṛioen.
29:39: Qaṛun, Ferɛun, Haman, niɣ iusa ten id Musa, s ubeggen. Smeɣwṛen iman nnsen, di tmurt, ur rbiḥen.
29:40: Yal wa, Newwet it ɣef ubekkaḍ is. Llan wid iwumi Nuzen tabuciḍant. Llan wid i iwwet usuɣu. Llan wid i Nger seddaw wakal. Llan wid i Neɣmeq. Mačči d Ṛebbi iten idensen, d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.
29:41: Wid iteddun d imawlan, war Ṛebbi, cban rtila. Tebna tissist. Ihi, axxam ahcican maḍi, d tissist n rtila, lemmer ssinen.
29:42: Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa akw ayen uɣuṛ naɛṛen, war Neţţa. Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
29:43: Imedyaten agi, Neţţawi ten id, i lɣaci. Siwa imusnawen ara ten ifehmen.
29:44: Ixleq Ṛebbi tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ. Ih, deg waya, assekni i lmumnin.
29:45: Mel ayen i k id iţţuweḥḥan si Tezmamt. Bedd i tẓallit. Ih, taẓallit teţţekkes lɛaṛ, tuccḍa. War ccek, iugar iţ usmekti n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu tṣenɛam.
